title: Market Chatter: Paramount Skydance Nears $24 Billion Gulf Funding to Back Warner Bros. Discovery Takeover
title_zh: 市场热议：派拉蒙 Skydance 获得近 240 亿美元海湾资金支持华纳兄弟探索频道收购
summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is close to securing about $24 billion in equity from major Gulf sovereign
summary_zh: 派拉蒙 Skydance (PSKY) 即将从海湾主要主权国家获得约 240 亿美元的股权

title: Dow Jones Futures Fall As Trump Sees Iran Deal Or 'Hell'; Sandisk Leads 7 Stocks To Watch
title_zh: 特朗普认为伊朗协议或“地狱”，道琼斯期货下跌； Sandisk 领衔 7 只值得关注的股票
summary: President Trump threatened huge Tuesday attacks, saying Iran will be "in hell" if the Strait of Hormuz isn't opened. A market rally attempt is underway, but look for this signal.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统周二威胁要发动大规模袭击，称如果不开放霍尔木兹海峡，伊朗将“陷入地狱”。市场正在尝试反弹，但请留意这一信号。

title: Gulf Funds Near Deal to Back Paramount’s $81 Billion Takeover of Warner
title_zh: 海湾基金即将达成协议支持派拉蒙以 810 亿美元收购华纳
summary: Paramount  is in talks to secure signed equity commitments of close to $24 billion from three sovereign-wealth funds led by Saudi Arabia to help back its takeover of  Warner Bros. Discovery  according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，派拉蒙正在就沙特阿拉伯牵头的三个主权财富基金签署的近 240 亿美元的股权承诺进行谈判，以帮助其收购华纳兄弟探索公司。

title: Is the Trump Bull Market in Its Final Act? History Offers a Decisive Answer.
title_zh: 特朗普牛市已进入最后阶段？历史给出了决定性的答案。
summary: Historical precedent may be the insurmountable headwind that Wall Street's bull market can't overcome.
summary_zh: 历史先例或许是华尔街牛市无法克服的逆风。

title: Is Salesforce (CRM) Now Offering Value After A 26% One Year Share Price Fall?
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 在股价一年下跌 26% 后现在还能提供价值吗？
summary: If you are wondering whether Salesforce at around US$187 represents value or risk at this point, this article will help you view the stock through a clear valuation lens.
summary_zh: 如果您想知道此时 187 美元左右的 Salesforce 代表价值还是风险，本文将帮助您通过清晰的估值视角来看待该股票。
